product_one_liner.value: Ordway automates subscription and usage-based billing, accounts receivable, and revenue recognition for recurring-revenue businesses, particularly SaaS and other technology companies.
product_one_liner.notes: Product and target users are described on Ordway’s company and subscription billing pages.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage offers a demo/contact path but the navigation and footer do not show a pricing link; no public pricing page was found.

named_customers.notes: All three are shown among Ordway customer case studies.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn places Ordway in the 51–200 range and lists 64 employees; 64 falls in the requested 51–100 band.

hq_location.notes: Ordway identifies its headquarters in Washington, DC.

founded_year.notes: Ordway’s leadership page says founder Sameer Gulati founded the company in 2018.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index is primarily finance/product education and marketing content; it does not show at least two engineer-authored posts about how Ordway’s product is built.

public_docs.notes: Ordway has a public support portal with multiple article categories, including getting started, integrations, API, analytics, FAQs, and release notes.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current careers listing includes an open Product Manager – AI Finance role; its posting provides an Apply Now link.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed Ordway’s AI product information, public support portal, and AI/MCP content; they discuss AI workflows and connecting external assistants but do not state which model or provider Ordway’s product itself uses.

compliance_certs.notes: Ordway names a SOC 2 Type 2 report. The cited page does not name the other certifications in scope.

last_funding.notes: Ordway announced access to $20 million in additional equity and debt growth capital on August 5, 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 2026 funding announcement is within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page lists an Account Executive opening with an application link.

launched_6mo.notes: The changelog lists Discount Tables for Matrix Pricing in September 2026, a new usage-based pricing feature within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The leadership page lists a small, checkable executive team but gives no indication a C-level or VP-level person joined within the prior 12 months; the company news page shows no announcement of a leadership departure in that period.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Ordway’s integrations information names Salesforce and HubSpot as CRM integrations.
